text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens: dark green and light green curly/ruffled leaves, some broad flat spinach-like leaves with a glossy sheen, dressed and slightly wet; piled loosely in the center-left and spreading to the right over a white square plate, roughly 60-65% of the plate area, mounded about 3-4 cm high | 120

ITEM 2 | Thin shredded carrot strands, bright orange, matchstick-like, about 3-5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, scattered among the greens with a slightly glossy, moist look | 12

ITEM 3 | Dark reddish-purple leaves and stems (red leaf lettuce or similar), limp and glossy, sitting in the right-center of the greens, about 6-8 cm across and about 1 cm high | 15

ITEM 4 | Light dressing or oil residue, glossy wet sheen visible on the leaves and pooled faintly on the plate surface around the greens, no distinct pooled volume | 8
